titulo: Peels in a bowl, one walk at the end
caption:
Peels in a bowl, one walk at the end

The peels go into a bowl on the counter, not on a trip to the bin every thirty seconds. One walk at the end.

Setting the bowl down first takes five seconds, and the counter stays clear while you cook.

For whoever puts a bowl out for the scraps before they start cooking.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a large orange on the right. A ink-black block figure with trembling narrowed eyes walks in from the left, its eyes go wide, and a bowl appears on the counter in the middle. Three orange peels hop into the bowl one after another. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me, I'll bin it all later, to: bowl first. one trip.
